d:
The Knicks defeated the Cavaliers, 121-102 tonight in New York. Jose Alvarado finished with a team-high 21 points along with 5 three pointers and 3 assists for the Knicks, while Mikal Bridges tallied 19 points, 8 rebounds and 2 assists in the game. Donovan Mitchell recorded 30 points, 4 rebounds and 4 steals. The Knicks improve their record to 12-6 with the win, while the Cavaliers fall to 9-10 for the season.
